chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Since everyone else has a verified alibi or witnessed task, Macroon is the only one who has been completely isolated, making them the most suspicious choice for ejection.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Macroon, you've been in Weapons for several rounds, so it's highly unlikely you didn't see a single person pass by the corridor; if you can't name anyone, it's too risky to keep you on board.
